extracted.intended_audience: researchers, economists, policy analysts, students seeking country macroeconomic indicators
extracted.subtask_description: A compiled list of country rankings across multiple macroeconomic indicators (investment, public debt, current account, reserves) with reported values and the year of information. Useful as a reference dataset for cross-country comparison circa 2003.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investment (gross fixed)(% of GDP)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rank   Country                           Investment (gross fixed)(% of GDP)  Date of Information
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tabulated ranking of countries by gross fixed capital formation as a percentage of GDP (values shown, typically for 2003). Includes country name, percentage value, and year; labeled with Rank code @2185. Document note: 'This file was last updated on 10 February, 2005.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Public debt(% of GDP)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rank   Country                           Public debt(% of GDP)  Date of Information
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tabulated ranking of countries by public debt as a percentage of GDP (values shown, mostly for 2003, some 'est.' annotations). Includes country name, percent value, and year; labeled with Rank code @2186. Document note: 'This file was last updated on 10 February, 2005.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Current account balance
rubrics_metrics.description: Rank   Country                           Current account balance  Date of Information
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tabulated ranking of countries by current account balance (absolute USD amounts shown, positive and negative), with the year of information (primarily 2003). Includes country name and dollar amount; labeled with Rank code @2187. Document note: 'This file was last updated on 10 February, 2005.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Reserves of foreign exchange & gold
rubrics_metrics.description: Rank   Country                           Reserves of foreign exchange & gold  Date of Information
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tabulated ranking of countries by foreign exchange and gold reserves (absolute USD amounts shown, primarily for 2003). Includes country name, reserve amount, and year; labeled with Rank code @2188. Document note: 'This file was last updated on 10 February, 2005.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix A - Abbreviations
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix A lists abbreviations and their expansions (e.g., ABEDA: Arab Bank for Economic Development in Africa; AfDB: African Development Bank; etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides definitions of acronyms used elsewhere in the dataset to aid interpretation of entries and institutional references.
